title: Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Michiko Konda
entities.description: A woman who worked to heal the land and entrusts the future to her sister, per her journal.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: A place on Kamigawa whose architect is Onyx-Eye; site of an uprising.

entities.name: Asari Uprisers
entities.description: A rebel faction led by Risona, joined by Isshin.

entities.name: Kiki-Jiki
entities.description: A being blessed by Keiga who would one day master the art of duplication.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: A city built using timber clear-cut from the Jukai Forest.

entities.name: Jukai Forest
entities.description: A once-peaceful forest that grew violently hostile to outsiders after being clear-cut.

entities.name: Imperial Palace
entities.description: The palace at whose gates two visions of freedom clashed.

entities.name: Greasefang, Okiba Boss
entities.description: A deadly Okiba boss with a bike and a dangerous bite.

entities.name: Hinata, Dawn-Crowned
entities.description: A figure associated with hope and sunlit hooves.

entities.name: Isshin, Two Heavens as One
entities.description: A swordsman trained by the Imperials who joined the Asari Uprising.

entities.name: Imperials
entities.description: The Imperial faction that trained Isshin.

entities.name: Raiyuu, Storm's Edge
entities.description: A warrior who considers the tempest the only ally needed.

events.summary: Michiko Konda writes that she must entrust the future to her sister.
events.quote: now I must entrust the future to my sister

events.summary: Kiki-Jiki is blessed by Keiga, the Tide Star.
